messages:
Priya: quick follow-up from last night's postmortem. want to turn notes into clear owners + deadlines so aggregation drift doesn't recur.
Jesse: yep. I'll own ETL side; found retries spiking on a specific shard during bursts.
Marta: taking instrumentation. will look at client SDK defaults and server-side sampler.
Riley: I'll handle rollout/process items: pre-deploy reconcile CI and runbook updates.
Kaya: thanks. let's enumerate concrete tasks (short): 1) ETL retry hot-shard investigation - Jesse - 2024-11-01 2) Aggregator reconciliation query + daily job - Sam - 2024-10-28 3) Sampling defaults audit - Marta - 2024-10-26 4) Pre-deploy reconcile CI job - Riley - 2024-10-30 5) Schema drift detection alert - Priya - 2024-10-25
Sam: I'll take reconciliation job. plan: run diff on 1h windows, persist deltas, alert on >0.5% or >5k delta.
Jesse: repro commands I'm starting: `./infra/etl/run_shard_repro --shard s42 --window 2h` will post logs. suspect an Nagle-related batching issue.
Marta: quick query I ran in staging: ```sql
select service, count(*) as total, sum(case when span_id is null then 1 else 0 end) as missing
from traces
where ts > now() - interval '3 days'
group by service
order by missing desc
limit 20;
```
Marta: results show ingest service has ~0.8% missing spans last 72h, concentrated on mobile clients.
Priya: for alerts I'll create two signals: schema_mismatch (immediate) and aggregator_delta_pct (rolling 1h). PD escalation: P1 if delta>2% for 30m.
Riley: pre-deploy CI plan: run reconciliation on a 5m sampled window from canary traffic. will add job in infra/cicd with timeout 3m. owner: Riley.
Kaya: process note: set a 6-week follow-up cadence. weekly 20m check-ins; rotating lead: Sam, Jesse, Marta, Priya, Riley, Kaya. first check 2024-10-31.
Jesse: found a flaky worker config (tcp_keepalive disabled) on node pool. will patch and roll at 02:00 UTC. eng-sre-bot schedule?
eng-sre-bot: scheduled: rolling restart of etl-pool by Jesse on 2024-10-29 02:00 UTC. auto-rollback if 1% error increase.
Sam: reconciliation SQL I'll use (posting small snippet): ```sql
-- reconcile raw vs aggregator per key
select key, sum(raw_count) as raw, sum(agg_count) as agg, (sum(raw_count)-sum(agg_count)) as delta
from raw_events r left join aggregator a using (key, window)
where ts >= :start and ts < :end
group by key
having abs((sum(raw_count)-sum(agg_count))) > 0
order by delta desc
limit 100;
```
Marta: propose dashboard metric: `agg_delta_95pct_1h` and alert when >1% or >10k. I'll add a panel and alert rule. ETA: 2024-10-27.
Priya: one more recurring pattern: schema bumps during deploys cause field renames -> aggregator misses keys. propose a lightweight CI lint that checks model/schema diffs. Riley can add to pre-deploy.
Riley: yep, will add schema diff check to canary pipeline. if key fields removed or renamed, block and notify owner.
Kaya: ownership summary to paste into postmortem doc: ETL/ops: Jesse (fix + restart), Reconcile job: Sam (daily job + alert), Instrumentation: Marta, Alerts & PD: Priya, CI/process: Riley.
Jesse: posting initial GH issue and linking to postmortem: https://github.com/redwood/infra/issues/4899 (ETL retry investigation).
Sam: created infra job ticket: https://github.com/redwood/platform/issues/3021 (reconcile daily job).
Marta: PR to change SDK sampler default coming; will cc QA for mobile.
Priya: I pushed draft PD escalation and alert docs: https://pagerduty.local/ops/obs-drift-draft. please review before I enable.
Kaya: timeline + check-ins OK. I'll create the milestone `obs-remediation-2024q4` and link all issues.
Riley: small playbook entry suggestion: if aggregator delta > threshold, run quick backfill snapshot for affected keys, mark consumer downstream as degraded, and open incident ticket. I'll add to runbook.
Marta: backfill approach: snapshot for >48h windows, streaming patches for <48h. will include resource estimates in PR.
Jesse: after restart I'll monitor for 24h. will post health summary in the thread.
eng-sre-bot: reminder: weekly obs follow-up sync scheduled 2024-10-31 10:00 UTC. attendees: Sam, Jesse, Marta, Priya, Riley, Kaya.
Kaya: thanks all. please convert any action into GH tasks and tag milestone. ping me if blockers pop up. :thumbsup:
